title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11471)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11471) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11471). This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 2551-1981 'Machine-made textile floor coverings — Determination of dimensional changes due to the effects of varied water and heat conditions' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Textile Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is especially drawn to the following: Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while In Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
